## Authorization
<!-- severity: error -->
<!-- scope: {{handler_paths}} -->
<!-- Derived from manifest.architecture.auth -->

- Every externally reachable handler (route, endpoint, command, resolver) MUST check authorization before acting
- Pattern used in this project: `{{auth_pattern}}`
- Example from this codebase: `{{auth_example}}`
- Authorization is checked on the specific resource being acted on, not only on the user's role

{{#if tenancy}}
## Tenant Isolation
<!-- severity: error -->
<!-- scope: {{entity_paths}}, {{validation_paths}} -->
<!-- Derived from manifest.architecture.tenancy -->

- Every tenant-owned entity MUST carry `{{scope_column}}` and use the project's scoping mechanism: `{{tenancy_mechanism}}`
- Every query against a tenant-owned entity MUST be scoped to the current tenant; unscoped "fetch all" calls are a violation
- Lookups by id in validation and input handling MUST be constrained to the current tenant
- The scope escape hatch (`{{tenancy_escape_hatch}}`) MUST NOT be used without a written justification next to the call
{{/if}}

## Data Exposure
<!-- severity: error -->
<!-- scope: {{handler_paths}}, {{serializer_paths}} -->
<!-- Derived from manifest.security.sensitive_fields -->

- These fields MUST never reach a client: `{{sensitive_fields}}`
- Serialization approach in this project: `{{serialization_approach}}`
- Raw entities MUST NOT be passed to the response layer; always go through the serialization approach above

## Injection Prevention
<!-- severity: error -->

- No queries built from string concatenation or interpolation; use parameter binding or the query builder
- No user input in shell commands, file paths, or outbound requests without validation against an allowlist
- Output rendered as HTML MUST use the framework's default escaping; raw output only for sanitized content

## Secrets
<!-- severity: error -->

- No credentials, API keys, or tokens in source files
- Configuration is read through `{{config_access_pattern}}`; application code does not read raw environment variables

{{#if file_storage}}
## File Access
<!-- severity: warning -->
<!-- scope: {{storage_paths}} -->
<!-- Derived from manifest.architecture.file_storage -->

- Storage location: `{{file_storage_location}}`
- Authorization MUST be verified before serving or streaming a stored file
- Uploads MUST be validated for type and size before being stored
{{/if}}
